name: QwenPaw Webhook
description: Generic webhook integration for QwenPaw: inbound HTTP trigger, send_webhook agent tool, and outbound Webhook channel.

description_i18n.zh-CN: QwenPaw 通用 Webhook 插件：入站 HTTP 触发、send_webhook 工具与出站 Webhook 频道。
description_i18n.en-US: Generic webhook integration for QwenPaw: inbound HTTP trigger, send_webhook tool, and outbound Webhook channel.

author: flipped0419

tools.name: send_webhook
tools.description: Send a notification to a trusted preconfigured webhook target alias.

config_fields.name: targets_file
config_fields.label: Targets file
config_fields.help: Optional. Defaults to QWENPAW_WEBHOOK_TARGETS_FILE or QwenPaw's secret directory.

config_fields.name: allow_raw_url
config_fields.label: Allow raw URL
config_fields.help: Recommended off. When off, the model can only use administrator-defined target aliases.
